content_blocks.label: clause_1._Scope_of_Confidential_Information
content_blocks.text: Confidential Information includes any information disclosed by the Disclosing Party, whether in written, oral, electronic, or other form.

content_blocks.label: clause_2._Obligations
content_blocks.text: The Receiving Party shall maintain the confidentiality of the Confidential Information and shall not disclose it to any third party without the prior written consent of the Disclosing Party.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Duration
content_blocks.text: This Agreement shall remain in effect indefinitely until terminated in writing by either Party.

content_blocks.label: notary_note
content_blocks.text: Sworn before me this 10th day of April 2024.
